name: Reborn as a Noble Lady
source:
You were once a rising star in the entertainment industry, Li Wei, but after an accident, you are reincarnated as Qian Jingyi, the heiress of the Qian family. 

After your rebirth, you find yourself facing power struggles, a fake marriage, and the rekindling of lost friendships as you navigate this complex world.

Your new husband, Sheng Jiachen, is handsome and aloof, and your marriage seems like a mere family compromise. However, as time passes, you uncover the subtle tenderness beneath his cold exterior. How will this relationship evolve? 

Meanwhile, you must also deal with five men who are deeply intertwined with your fate. How will you balance family responsibilities, friendships, and your unfulfilled dreams on stage?

[From [url=https://illumination-works.itch.io/reborn-as-a-noble-lady]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你曾经是娱乐圈的后起之秀李薇，却在一场意外之后转世为钱家女继承人钱静宜。

重生后，你发现自己在这个复杂的世界中面临着权力斗争、假婚姻以及失去的友谊的重燃。

你的新婚丈夫盛嘉辰英俊而孤傲，你们的婚姻似乎只是家庭的妥协。然而，随着时间的推移，你会发现他冰冷外表下隐藏着微妙的温柔。这种关系将如何发展？

与此同时，你还必须应对五个与你的命运深深交织在一起的男人。你将如何平衡家庭责任、友谊和舞台上未实现的梦想？

[来自[url=https://illumination-works.itch.io/reborn-as-a-noble-lady]Itch.io[/url]]
